high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Noah Smith (@Noahpinion) on Twitter. The tweet states, "The wealth of 30-year-old Americans is now well ahead of where it was a generation ago." Below the tweet is a graph titled "Generational Wealth per Capita," which shows inflation-adjusted data using PCEPI (Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index) up to 2023Q3. The graph is created by Jeremy Horpedahl (@jmhorp). The graph displays three lines representing different generational cohorts: Baby Boomers (yellow line), Generation X (green line),
